linx_native_interface.model_at_tabulation_nodes: log R_i(T) = log R_med_i(T) + s_i(T)*q_i, s_i=log(expsigma_i)
linx_native_interface.default_q: all zero; no random joint prior imposed by this call
linx_native_interface.correlated_amplitudes: draw z with covariance I; q=Lz where L L^T=C_q; pass same q to both adapters with reaction ordering checked
linx_native_interface.expressible_covariance: Cov[log R_i(T), log R_j(Tprime)] = s_i(T)*C_q[i,j]*s_j(Tprime) at grid nodes / compatible log interpolation
linx_native_interface.boundary: One tabular q_i per reaction is one latent input. With linear interpolation of rates the log-rate curve is nonlinear between nodes, so covariance rank can exceed one without adding a latent direction. Analytic/custom rate parameterizations require their own contract.

inputs_required: joint S-factor posterior or joint rate-function samples
general_extension: If the posterior requires several temperature modes, use log R_i(T)=log Rmed_i(T)+sum_k B_ik(T) z_k or supplied joint tables through an explicit adapter. Do not squeeze arbitrary rate-function covariance into one q_i.

counterfactual.B: product of the SAME marginal rate-function posteriors
counterfactual.non_gaussian_case: resample product marginals; zero covariance alone does not establish independence
counterfactual.prior_work: S3_COVARIANCE; this is its interface continuation, not a new physical result

observational_eta_policy: Declare free eta_BBN versus CMB conditioning and photon-production map eta_BBN→eta_CMB; count shared CMB information once.

rank_contract.coordinates: Declare independent latent coordinates z, their measure/support, reaction ordering and a finite common temperature grid. For singular input measures parameterize their actual support first.
rank_contract.input_dimension: r is the number of independent latent coordinates in this declared smooth representation, not a universal information-theoretic dimension.
rank_contract.local_active_dimension: r_loc(z)=rank(dF/dz), F=log R on positive-rate grid; r_loc <= r. Redundant inputs may be invisible, singular points may lower the local rank.
rank_contract.regular_rank_diagnostic: ess_sup_mu rank(dF/dz), with stated measure and smooth regular-domain assumptions; not by itself a characterization of global posterior/support.
rank_contract.coordinate_invariance: Local Jacobian rank is invariant under differentiable coordinate changes with invertible derivatives; covariance rank/spectrum need not be invariant under nonlinear output changes.
rank_contract.affine_log_case: At nodes / log interpolation, F=m+S q and Cov(F)=S Cq S^T. One reaction has rank <=1, full joint map rank <=number of q amplitudes.
rank_contract.linear_rate_case: R=sum_k w_k exp(m_k+s_k q), w_k>=0 within valid table; d2(log R)/dq2=Var_p(s), p_k=w_k exp(m_k+s_k q)/R. A curved one-dimensional support can have covariance rank 2.

adapter_checks_required: Match correlated q=Lz across reactions and preserve reaction ordering.
Distinguish rank-two covariance for one reaction at two temperatures from rank-two covariance for two reactions.
Compare joint function samples on common nodes and inter-node temperatures; record interpolation, units, valid domain and tails.
Compare latent measure, active directions, non-Gaussian structure and posterior predictive abundances.
Keep same marginal function posteriors in correlation-removal counterfactual; do not change within-channel temperature law.

laboratory_pushforward.convention: p eight lab energies then n eight; sigma=4*pi*a0, C_sigma=(4*pi)^2*C_a0; E_cm=E_lab/2 for d+d.
laboratory_pushforward.rank_ceiling: C_R=W C_lab W^T: rank<=16, channel<=8 only for the specified fixed linear map of these measurements; not a ceiling on an augmented functional posterior.
laboratory_pushforward.coordinate_change: xprime=D x implies Cprime=D C D^T AND Wprime=W D^-1; physical output covariance unchanged. A random PSD surrogate with fixed W after scaling does not measure Leonard information loss.
missing_physics: quadrature weights for irregular energies and consistent reduced-mass/rate units
additional normalization and energy errors; avoid double counting
laboratory_pushforward.compression_criterion: Compare full and compressed joint rate-function distributions and propagated observable distributions (Yp,D/H; other abundances if declared); quantify error relative to a predefined scientific tolerance. No measured 8:1 deficit.
laboratory_pushforward.posterior_scope: C_R alone defines a full Gaussian model only with a declared Gaussian approximation and mean. Covariance alone does not define general P(R).

measured_band_diagnostic_20261126.observable: Partial Maxwell integrals of the 16 measured cross sections; piecewise-linear S or sigma with fixed energies, no extrapolation or additional scale term.

s3_external_response_20261120.observable: d ln(Y_p)/dq for d+d -> t+p in LINX versus d ln(Y_p)/dp in PRyMordial/Burns
